about: Slayer masters placed by the Slayer thread (Slayer step 2): Aya, who holds Turael's place once While Guthix Sleeps is done (every quest counts as done), in the house in Burthorpe (reached by ::tele 2931 3536), and Spria in her house in Draynor Village. Vannaka is in edgeville-dungeon.json. Slayer step 3 adds, built in place outside Misthalin and reached by ::tele: Mazchna in Canifis (::tele 3511 3509), Chaeldar in Zanaris (::tele 2444 4431), Steve at the Stronghold Slayer Cave's entrance in the Tree Gnome Stronghold (::tele 2432 3423) and Kuradal upstairs in Duradel's hut in Shilo Village (::tele 2869 2982 1), by their every-quest-done types slayer_master_2_mazchna, slayer_master_4, slayer_master_steve and slayer_master_5_kuradal; mejrs lists Mazchna (402), Steve (490) and Duradel (405) under their older types. Tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live; it lists them under their older ids 401 and 10440), checked against the OSRS Wiki's map pins (Turael and Aya 2931,3536; Spria 3091,3267) and the 242 cache's types slayer_master_1_aya and slayer_master_9_active. The wander ranges are guessed.
